dimensions.description: Perception of contract honor, trade honesty, and truth in broadcasts.
Perception of martial readiness, perimeter fortification, and defensive deterrence.
Willingness to shelter strangers, grant medical aid, and share food reserves.
Willingness to retaliate with lethal force, execute raiders, and tolerate collateral damage.
Perception of resource abundance, rare medicine, scrap reserves, and battery power.

tags.description: Known as a refuge for the wounded and displaced.
Regular trading caravans route through the shelter due to reliable trade volume.
Raiders and skirmishers actively avoid attacking the hardened perimeter.
Fearsome reputation makes merchants cautious and armed escorts standard.
History of broken agreements causes merchants to charge severe risk premiums.
Steadfast agreements and clear trade terms win goodwill across all factions.
Perceived as starving and vulnerable, attracting scavengers and predatory deals.
Feared by outlaw bands; roaming scouts give the shelter a wide berth.
